note.value: Quire signatures are marked vertically in the bottom margin of the first page of a quire. Quires of 10 ff. with the exception of quires V, XII, XIII (8 ff.) and quire XXIII (13 ff.), which are nonetheless complete.
Reinforcement strips derive from a Syriac parchment manuscript: ff. 1r, 2r, 3v, 27r, 35r–v, 36r, 45r, 54v, 55r, 64v, 75r, 84v, 94v, 95r, 104r–v, 105r, 107v–108r, 181r, 190v, 191r, 200v.
Two wooden boards bound in leather. Pastedowns from a Syriac parchment manuscript attached to the binding board. Red leather bookmarks.

program.description: Catalogued as part of UCLA Library's "Identification and Description of the Syriac and Arabic Manuscripts at St. Catherine’s Monastery of the Sinai, Phase 1: Syriac Parchment Manuscripts" project (2022-2025), funded by the National Endowment for the Humanities. Principle cataloguers were Grigory Kessel (Lead cataloguer), Natalia Smelova (Associate cataloguer), and Vevian Zaki (Cataloguer for Arabic content in Syriac manuscripts).

program.description: Digitized under the Sinai Library Digitization Project, Phase 1 (2018-2023), a collaboration of St. Catherine’s Monastery of the Sinai, the Early Manuscripts Electronic Library, and UCLA Library, with funding from the Arcadia Fund, the Ahmanson Foundation, and the Steinmetz Family Foundation.
